gloss: transfer destination; account to transfer to

definitions.gloss: transfer destination; account to transfer money to
definitions.explanation: The bank account or financial institution designated to receive a money transfer.

examples.japanese: {振込先|ふりこみさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the account to transfer to.

examples.japanese: {振込先|ふりこみさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口座番号|こうざばんごう}→口座番号：16092_kouzabangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。

examples.japanese: {振込先|ふりこみさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you enter the wrong transfer destination, it can take time to get a refund.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧ (bank transfer) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). Essential vocabulary for anyone dealing with banking or payments in Japan, where bank transfers (⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧) are a common payment method.
